title: SwiftData: models, queries, relationships and migration

videos.script: This lesson is read, not practised, and it says so now. SwiftData exists only in Apple's SDKs. {{wall}} On the course's machine the compiler refuses the import in one line, and you will see it. {{records}} So you read how the planner stores its courses and sessions. Two classes, one macro each, and SwiftUI watching them. Why records, and not lesson 1's values? Because the values must keep building on Linux. {{query}} Then a query, which fetches and keeps itself current. Its parts are a predicate and a sort, and those are Foundation's, so they run. {{refused}} You will also see a predicate the compiler refuses, and why. {{delete}} Then what deleting a course takes with it. Saving, autosave and undo. {{migrate}} And migration: the store that already exists on somebody's phone, opened by the next version of your code.
